Who may attend Faculty Senate meetings and where are they held?
Any member of the URl community or the general public may attend a Faculty Senate
meeting.However,only voting members of the Senate may vote on legislation,resolutions,
officer elections,and any other business raised at the meeting.Bylaws stipulate that only
Senators and ex officio members have the RIGHT to speak during meetings.Exofficio
members participate in discussions,ask questions,and make and second motions;theyare
not,however,allowed tovote.Non-senators may request to speak at a meeting beforehand
via the online Permission To Speak”form found on the Faculty Senate website.To facilitate
the meeting itself
Meetings take place throughout the academic year in the Hope Roomof the Higgins
Welcome Center from3-5p.m.monthly on a Thursday.A brief reception with refreshments is
provided at every meeting.This is a wonderful opportunity for in-person attendees to network
colleges

Doesthe Faculty Senate use parliamentary procedures to conduct meetings?
The Senate relies upon the American Institute of Parliamentarians Standard Codeof
Parliamentary Procedure.Guidebooks and other reference materials are available in the
Faculty Senate Office.Training on procedural basics is provided during the annual
Orientation meeting.This meeting is held each September and is required for all new
Senators(and highly recommended as a refresher for ALL Senators).
